programs.match_basis: NOFO-specific; do not hard-code 75/25 across cycles
programs.eligibility_guard: Track future cycles only after live FEMA/NOFO verification.

programs.match_basis: Project-specific. Confirm applicable feasibility and implementation cost-share treatment, base-plan/incremental-cost rules, LERRD treatment, and current district guidance before any funding calculation.
programs.eligibility_guard: Requires connection to qualifying dredging for an existing authorized Federal navigation project and agency determination; Section 204 is not generic levee, road, or dredging funding.

programs.program: Clean Water Act Section 319 Nonpoint Source Grants
programs.match_basis: IDEM states 60% grant / 40% recipient match for approved projects; watershed-management-plan-only projects may use 80/20
programs.eligibility_guard: Do not classify drainage/flood-control work as Section 319 eligible without program-specific review.

programs.authority: Indiana local road and bridge matching program
programs.match_basis: Population/category-specific under current INDOT rules; do not encode a universal 75/25 rule.
programs.engineering_guard: Requires applicable local asset-management and project eligibility checks.

programs.cycle: current_program_rules; solicitation timing requires live verification
programs.match_basis: Up to 50% federal share for qualifying categories; otherwise lower shares may apply.
programs.eligibility_guard: Applicant, rural-location, technology, site-control, environmental, timing and allowable-cost requirements must be verified. Do not model a $6M hydro project as receiving a 50% REAP grant; the renewable-energy grant request ceiling is $1M.

programs.program: Clean Electricity Investment Credit / Elective Pay
programs.match_basis: Credit amount depends on qualified property and applicable bonus, labor and other statutory requirements; elective pay is entity- and credit-specific.
programs.eligibility_guard: Do not represent Section 6417 as a blanket 30%, 40%, or 50% cash refund. Confirm applicable entity status, qualified facility/storage, pre-filing registration and credit requirements. Applicable governmental entities may use elective pay; ordinary taxable private entities generally require a different tax-credit pathway.

programs.match_basis: CDBG may pay a non-Federal share only where the underlying activity is otherwise CDBG-eligible and the other Federal program does not prohibit the use.
programs.eligibility_guard: Do not treat CDBG-MIT as an automatic match source or assume 100% coverage. Confirm the applicable HUD/State allocation, action plan, NOFO, eligible activity, duplication-of-benefits and match restrictions.
